# Moran School Trigger Anchor

This branch and pull request are intentionally kept open as the event surface for the Moran Homeschool external runner.

GitHub Actions posts timestamped `MORAN_HOMESCHOOL_REVIEW_TRIGGER` comments to the pull request. ChatGPT Work listens only for those PR comments and executes the current live Homeschool Daytime Review & Closeout workflow.

Do not merge this pull request while the external school runner is in use.
